title: understand prose v1
description: The results of the pass prose (corpus arxiv AX7.4): the prose items of each section, as ranges of sentence numbers with a kind. The result has no text of the paper other than the term of a definition.

id.description: the id of the section, as ax://paper/2401.00001#sec-3

prose.description: the prose items of the section, or an empty list

from.description: the number of the first sentence

to.description: the number of the last sentence

term.description: for a definition: the term that it defines, as the sentence writes it
